account:
Today I have been keeping my appointments: the morning office, ten o'clock market walk, noon at home, and now one o'clock town accounts. Tea is confirmed for three at the neighbour's east-bank cottage, at (16,-60,105). The secretary had been checking that address, so I have told them it is settled.

There has been much talk about the baker carrying wheat and sacks of bread. I saw the baker stock the market stall, bought two fresh loaves, and heard that eighty fresh loaves were ready for customers. The baker wants reliable wheat supplies from the mill; I have passed that request to the secretary, and tomorrow's scheduled mill inspection may be useful. The neighbour said the bakery's supposed decorations were only oven glow, having asked the baker directly. I have no evidence of special decorations myself.

Freight asked the baker to discuss a warehouse order privately at the bakery later. I do not know the order's contents or why privacy was requested; it could simply be business. More unusually, I have just heard the builder ask the secretary to bring me into the great hall tomorrow at exactly eighteen hundred for a brief lighting inspection. The builder carries a lantern, which fits that stated purpose, but the precise timing and request to arrange my presence catch my attention. Perhaps some preparations are being coordinated without my involvement, though I cannot yet say that these events are connected or that anything beyond ordinary trade and maintenance is happening.
